Name: Community Contracts
Author: KrigerJ
Description:
[b][size=4]Community Contracts v2.1.2[/size][/b]

Turn Stardew Valley into a thriving cooperative economy by partnering with townspeople through contracts, automation, and on‑demand services. Version [b]2.1.2[/b] is the most polished, player‑friendly release yet — removing dialogue interruptions, improving navigation, expanding services, and making it easier than ever to hire the right NPC for the job.

[b][size=4]Getting Started[/size][/b]

[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] if you haven’t already.[/*]
[*]Download and install [b]Community Contracts[/b].[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley and press [b]V[/b] to open the Community Contracts Toolbar.[/*]
[*]You can change the hotkey anytime from the [b]Settings Menu[/b] on the toolbar.[/*]
[*]All features, services, and configuration options are accessible directly from the toolbar.
See the Getting Started video [url=https://youtu.be/X-jR8DMylaM]HERE[/url].[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]What’s New in v2.1.2[/size][/b]
[heading][b][size=4]Dialogue Interruptions Removed[/size][/b][/heading]
All services are now accessed [b]exclusively through the toolbar[/b], meaning:
[list]
[*]No more clicking on NPCs to request services[/*]
[*]No more pop‑up dialogues interrupting gameplay[/*]
[*]No more breaking conversations with villagers[/*]
[/list]This makes the entire system smoother, faster, and far more immersive.
[heading][b][size=4]New Settings Menu + Improved Toolbar Navigation[/size][/b][/heading]
The toolbar has been redesigned for clarity and speed:
[list]
[*]A dedicated [b]Settings Menu[/b] is now accessible directly from the toolbar[/*]
[*]Hotkeys, service options, and mod preferences can be adjusted instantly[/*]
[*]Navigation between menus is cleaner and more intuitive[/*]
[/list][heading][b][size=4]All NPCs Now Appear in the Character Menu[/size][/b][/heading]
Every villager capable of gaining friendship — including [b]modded NPCs[/b] — now appears in the Character Menu and can be hired for services.
The Character Menu now displays:
[list]
[*][b]NPC Level[/b][/*]
[*][b]Friendship Points[/b][/*]
[*]Sorted automatically from [b]highest → lowest friendship[/b][/*]
[/list]This makes it incredibly easy to choose the best worker for each job.
[heading][b][size=4]Animal Product Processing Service[/size][/b][/heading]
Hire a character to process:
[list]
[*]Eggs → Mayo[/*]
[*]Milk → Cheese[/*]
[*]Wool → Cloth[/*]
[*]Truffles → Oil[/*]
[/list]Features:
[list]
[*]Quality matches the raw goods[/*]
[*]Pulls items from your [b]backpack[/b] and [b]autograbbers[/b][/*]
[*]Works across all farm buildings[/*]
[/list][heading][b][size=4]Juicing Service[/size][/b][/heading]
Hire a character to turn:
[list]
[*]Fruit[/*]
[*]Vegetables[/*]
[*]Select forageables[/*]
[/list]…into [b]juice[/b].
Details:
[list]
[*]Juice quality matches raw goods[/*]
[*]Output quantity scales with item value[/*]
[*]Always profitable when sold[/*]
[*]Uses items from your backpack[/*]
[/list][heading][b][size=4]Direct Delivery to the Shipping Bin[/size][/b][/heading]
For all raw‑goods processing services, you can now choose:
[list]
[*]Deliver finished products to your [b]Delivery Chest[/b], or[/*]
[*]Deliver directly to the [b]Shipping Bin[/b] for next‑day profit[/*]
[/list][heading][b][size=4]Multiple Workers for Large Jobs[/size][/b][/heading]
Some services now support [b]multiple NPCs working simultaneously[/b], dramatically speeding up large tasks on big farms.
This is especially useful for:
[list]
[*]Large harvests[/*]
[*]Big processing batches[/*]
[*]High‑volume automation tasks[/*]
[/list][b]Expanded Language Support (Now 11 Languages)[/b]
Community Contracts now supports all of the following languages:
[list]
[*]English[/*]
[*]French[/*]
[*]Italian[/*]
[*]German[/*]
[*]Spanish[/*]
[*]Portuguese‑BR[/*]
[*]Russian[/*]
[*]Japanese[/*]
[*]Korean[/*]
[*][b]Turkish[/b] (new in v2.1.2)[/*]
[*][b]Hungarian[/b] (new in v2.1.2)[/*]
[/list]This brings full support for all official Stardew Valley languages.

[b][size=4]Existing Features from v2.1.1 (Still Included) [/size][/b]

[size=4]Farming Services[/size]
[list]
[*]Planting[/*]
[*]Tilling[/*]
[*]Watering[/*]
[*]Garden Pot placement[/*]
[*]Bee House placement[/*]
[*]Honey collection + optional mead processing[/*]
[*]Animal care[/*]
[*]Seed making[/*]
[/list][size=4]Other Services[/size]
[list]
[*]Sashimi making[/*]
[*]Ore processing[/*]
[*]Tapper installation[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]Reliable crop harvesting[/*]
[*]Smarter crab pot placement, baiting, and harvesting[/*]
[*]Adjustable rectangular service areas[/*]
[/list][size=4]Core Systems[/size]
[list]
[*]Delivery chest with customizable colors and labels[/*]
[*]Contract growth tied to friendship and skill[/*]
[*]Specialist and non‑specialist NPC roles[/*]
[*]Optional processor time reduction[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Summary[/b][/size]
Community Contracts v2.1.2 is the most refined version yet — eliminating dialogue interruptions, improving navigation, expanding automation, and making NPC hiring smarter and more intuitive. Whether you’re running a small homestead or a massive industrial farm, this update makes the entire system smoother, faster, and more immersive.
